translations.1: And he said to him: 'Build me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams.'
translations.2: And he did so; and the two of them offered there a bull and a ram upon each altar.
translations.3: Then he said to him: 'Stand by your offering, while I go on — perhaps the decree of God will come to meet me; and whatever word God instructs me with, I will tell you of it.' And he went in stillness.
translations.4: And the decree of God came to Balaam; and he said: 'O Lord! I have already arranged seven altars, and offered there a bull and a ram upon each altar.'
translations.5: Then God instructed him with a word, and said: 'Return to Balak and speak thus.'
translations.6: So he returned to him — and behold, he was standing by his offering, he and all the chiefs of Moab.
translations.7: And he spoke his parable and said: 'From Aram, Balak king of Moab brought me, from the mountains of the east, saying: Come, curse for me the house of Jacob, and bring reproach upon the house of Israel.'
translations.8: 'How shall I curse him whom the All-Powerful has not cursed? And how shall I reproach him whom God has not reproached?'
translations.9: 'For I see him from the tops of the mountains, and I discern him from the heights — that he is a people who shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the rest of the nations.'
translations.10: 'O who can count the offspring of Jacob, and number the descendants of the house of Israel! I ask that I may die the death of the upright, and that my end may be like theirs.'
translations.11: Balak said to Balaam: 'What have you done to me? I invited you to curse my enemies — and behold, you have blessed them!'
translations.12: He answered, saying: 'Only that which God instructs me with — that I preserve and speak.'
translations.13: Balak said to him: 'Come with me to another place, from which you will see him — yet you will see part of him and not all of him — and curse him for me from there.'
translations.14: And he took him to the estate overlooking the top of the citadel; and he built there seven altars, and offered there a bull and a ram upon each altar.
translations.15: He said to Balak: 'Stand here by your offering, while I go to receive over there.'
translations.16: And the decree of God came to Balaam; and He instructed him with a word, and said: 'Return to Balak and speak thus.'
translations.17: So he came to him — and behold, he was standing by his offering, and the chiefs of Moab with him. And he said to him: 'What has God said?'
translations.18: And he spoke his parable and said: 'Arise, O Balak, and hear! Give ear to my words, O son of Zippor!'
translations.19: 'The All-Powerful is not like men that He should lie, nor like the sons of Adam that He should repent. Do you think He would say and not act, or speak and not fulfill it?'
translations.20: 'Indeed, blessings I have received — and so I bless them, and I shall not reverse it.'
translations.21: 'Whereby no iniquity is seen in the house of Jacob, nor deceit in the house of Israel — for God is their Lord with them, and the companionship of the King is theirs.'
translations.22: 'The All-Powerful who brought them out of Egypt — like the vigilance of the wild ox, prevailing over them.'
translations.23: 'And no omen can take hold in the house of Jacob, nor divination take effect in the house of Israel — rather, what the All-Powerful has done alone is what is declared to them.'
translations.24: 'For it is a people that rises like a lioness, and lifts itself up like a lion — that does not lie down until it has eaten its prey and drunk the blood of the slain.'
translations.25: Balak said to him: 'Since you will not curse him with a curse, then do not bless him with a blessing either.'
translations.26: He answered him, saying: 'Did I not already tell you that whatever God says — that I shall do?'
translations.27: He said: 'Come, let me take you to another place — perhaps it may be easy before God, and you shall curse him for me from there.'
translations.28: And he took him to the top of Peor, which overlooks the face of the vast expanse.
translations.29: He said: 'Build me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams.'
translations.36: And he did as Balaam had told him; and he offered there a bull and a ram upon each altar.
